raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Since the Megatron-LM core_v0.19.2 bump (#1321), `--use_turbo_mega_moe True` fails to build the model, and once that
is fixed MegaMoE silently routes with Megatron's `TopKRouter` instead of `PrimusTopKRouter`.

`PrimusTurboMegaMoELayer`:

- Accepts the `name` argument that `TransformerLayer` now passes (previously a `TypeError`).
- Builds shared experts from the new builder (`functools.partial`) the way `MoELayer` does; a `ModuleSpec` still works.
- Swaps in `PrimusTopKRouter` itself (`mega_moe_router()`, honouring `disable_primus_topk_router`). The router patch
  only swaps it in `MoELayer.__init__`, which MegaMoE replaces; its spec hook does not reach the GPT decoder spec.
  Megatron's router has no `even` force-load-balancing mode and draws random logits instead, so the lm loss at step
  10 was 8.79 instead of 5.56. With that router the run without MegaMoE reaches the same 8.79, so MegaMoE's numerics
  are not the cause.
- Accepts the extra arguments that Megatron-LM main passes (`hash_moe_layer_threshold`, `input_ids`,
  `packed_seq_params`) and forwards them to the router only when they are set. Checked against main's signatures in
  unit tests, not run end to end.

`megatron.moe.primus_topk_router`:

- `primus_topk_router_for()` holds the swap rule, and MegaMoE uses the same helper.
- The spec-builder wrappers also handle the core_v0.19 partial spec.
- The log no longer claims the `MoESubmodules()` default was patched.

`MoELayer` behaviour is unchanged.

Tests: `test_mega_moe.py` is updated for the partial spec, but it needs 8 gfx950 GPUs and never runs in CI (gfx942).
Two new tests that need no GPU (`backends/megatron/patches/test_topk_router_patches.py`,
`backends/megatron/test_mega_moe_layer_build.py`) cover the swap rule, the patch on the core_v0.19 spec, and how
MegaMoE is built and calls its router. On 8x MI355X `test_mega_moe.py` passes unmodified, all 14 tests (below).

## Results

DeepSeek-V3 proxy (EP4, 128 experts, top-8, GBS 64), Primus-Turbo `main` ff4898e4:

- 4x MI455X: `amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261019`, `run_deepseek_v3_proxy_mi455x.sh` defaults.
- 4x MI355X: `rocm/primus:v26.8` + FlyDSL 0.3.4.1 + aiter 0.1.24.post1, same arguments except attention on aiter and
  no hipBLASLt tuning file (the FlyDSL MLA kernels and the tuning file are gfx1250-only).

Correctness, 10 iterations, same on both GPUs:

| | lm loss, step 10 | grad norm, step 1 |
| --- | --: | --: |
| `main`, MegaMoE | TypeError | |
| `main` + the first two changes, MegaMoE (`TopKRouter`) | 8.79 | 3.444 |
| `disable_primus_topk_router: true`, with or without MegaMoE | 8.79 | 3.444 |
| this branch, with or without MegaMoE | 5.5630 | 3.810 |

With and without MegaMoE, loss and grad norms agree at every step (bitwise on MI455X, within run-to-run noise on
MI355X), so 8.79 comes from Megatron's random routing, not from MegaMoE. Without MegaMoE this branch matches `main`.

Speed, ms/iter, mean of iterations 21-40 of 40:

| routing | MI455X: without -> with MegaMoE | MI355X: without -> with MegaMoE |
| --- | --: | --: |
| `even` (default) | 1100.3 -> 1000.6 (1.100x) | 2366.0 -> 1660.5 (1.425x) |
| random (`disable_primus_topk_router: true`) | 1115.3 -> 1044.0 (1.068x) | 2394.3\* -> 1687.6 (1.419x) |

`even` puts each token's 8 experts on one rank, MegaMoE's best case. MegaMoE gains more on MI355X because the EP
all-to-all it removes is slower there (629 vs 144 ms/iter left uncovered by compute).

\* Excluding one 36 s stall: under random routing the gfx950 FlyDSL grouped GEMM recompiles for every new per-rank
token count (about 35 s each), a Primus-Turbo issue, not this PR. MegaMoE has no such stalls.

Before the bump (505e55e0), MegaMoE needs none of this and matches AMD-AGI/Primus-Turbo#582 on MI455X (+9.7% TFLOP/s/GPU;
#582: +9.8%).

Tests:

- `test_mega_moe.py` on 8x MI355X (EP8, unmodified): all 14 pass, mxfp8 included. On 4x MI455X (EP4, guards lifted)
  the 4 bf16 cases pass; mxfp8 stops at a FlyDSL link error in Primus-Turbo, outside this PR. bf16 cosine against
  Megatron's `MoELayer` on both: forward >= 0.99998, input gradient >= 0.9994, expert weight gradients >= 0.9988,
  router and shared expert >= 0.99999.
- The two new CPU tests pass (17); on `main` they fail.

### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the MegaMoE compatibility and router-selection changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR restores MegaMoE compatibility with Megatron-LM core_v0.19.2 after the upgrade in #1321, addressing model construction failures and incorrect router selection. **Changes:** - Accepts the new `name` argument and supports both shared-expert builders and legacy `ModuleSpec` definitions. - Selects `PrimusTopKRouter` for MegaMoE while respecting `disable_primus_topk_router`. - Updates parity tests to handle partial-based specifications and check router selection. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​unit_tests/​megatron/​moe/​test_mega_moe.py` | Adapts specification extraction, passes a module name, and asserts the Primus router type. | | `primus/​backends/​megatron/​core/​extensions/​mega_moe.py` | Adds constructor compatibility, shared-expert builder support, and router selection. |
Review effort: Balanced

<!-- pr-pundit-live:primus-1340-162698e9 -->
### PR Pundit review
3 findings.

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🔵 | Router swap rule duplicated with divergent logic and global `get_args()` dependency | `primus/backends/megatron/core/extensions/mega_moe.py:86` |
| 2 | 🔵 | Comments wrongly claim the reference `MoELayer` uses `PrimusTopKRouter` | `tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_mega_moe.py:190-210` |
| 3 | 🔵 | New pure-Python router and shared-expert logic lacks CPU unit tests | `tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_mega_moe.py:190-210` |

<details><summary>Nits and less certain findings (3)</summary>

**1. Router swap rule duplicated with divergent logic and global `get_args()` dependency** (`primus/backends/megatron/core/extensions/mega_moe.py:86`)

`mega_moe_router` copies the `TopKRouter`→`PrimusTopKRouter` rename rule and the `disable_primus_topk_router` check from `patched_moelayer_init` in `topk_router_patches.py`. A future change to the rule (a new router class, the deprecated MoE path) has to be made in both places. Consider sharing one helper. `get_args()` is reached only for routers named `TopKRouter`, and the layer already needed initialised args through `mega_moe_precision()`, so this adds no new construction requirement.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers changing the PrimusTopKRouter swap rule; there is no runtime impact for users of MegaMoE.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**2. Comments wrongly claim the reference `MoELayer` uses `PrimusTopKRouter`** (`tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_mega_moe.py:190-210`)

The retained comment 'mega layer reuses the same router/shared-expert submodules' in `_build_layers` is now only half true. MegaMoE receives the same `submodules`, but `mega_moe_router` turns `TopKRouter` into `PrimusTopKRouter`, while the unpatched reference `MoELayer` keeps plain `TopKRouter`. Parity therefore rests on `_create_args` turning off the PrimusTopKRouter-only branches (`enable_primus_turbo=False`, `router_logit_softcapping=None`, `moe_router_force_load_balancing=False`). The comment could say so. The new docstring and the new test comment are accurate: in a patched run, `MoELayer` still gets `PrimusTopKRouter` on v0.19.

**Who is affected:** Readers and maintainers of the MegaMoE parity test only; there is no runtime effect.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**3. New pure-Python router and shared-expert logic lacks CPU unit tests** (`tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_mega_moe.py:190-210`)

The new `mega_moe_router` and shared-experts dispatch are pure Python, but they are only exercised by `test_mega_moe.py`. That file skips at module level unless the GPU is gfx950, and its parity tests need 8 GPUs. Only the default `TopKRouter` -> `PrimusTopKRouter` swap is asserted. The `disable_primus_topk_router` opt-out, the passthrough for non-`TopKRouter` routers, the `ModuleSpec` vs builder-callable branch not taken by the pinned Megatron, and the `name + '.shared_experts'` propagation are untested. Consider small CPU tests, e.g. `mega_moe_router(TopKRouter) is PrimusTopKRouter` with a stubbed `get_args`.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers only: regressions in the opt-out or the version-dispatch branches would go unnoticed on CI runners without 8 gfx950 GPUs.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

</details>

<!-- ccr-overview-v2 -->

### 🔵 Needs a closer look

The missing Megatron submodule source leaves version-dependent builder and router contracts unverified, requiring maintainer review of the new hash-routing and packed-sequence forwarding beyond stub-based tests.

**No open issues** 🎉

<sub>Review effort: Balanced</sub>

## Unused import Import of 'gpt_layer_specs' is not used. ---

To fix this without changing functionality, remove only the unused imported symbol gpt_layer_specs from the import statement in tests/unit_tests/backends/megatron/patches/test_topk_router_patches.py, while keeping moe_module_specs imported from the same module. Keep the surrounding comment and import order unchanged so test patch timing behavior remains intact.

Concretely:

  • Edit the import at line 18 region.
  • Change from megatron.core.models.gpt import gpt_layer_specs, moe_module_specs # noqa: F401
    to from megatron.core.models.gpt import moe_module_specs.
  • No new methods, definitions, or additional imports are required.

+"""``megatron.moe.primus_topk_router``: its router swap rule, and the GPT MoE spec on Megatron-core 0.19+.
+
+From core 0.19 the MoE spec is ``functools.partial(MoELayer, submodules=MoESubmodules(...))`` with the
+router left at the dataclass default, which the patch's field-default edit does not reach.
+"""
+
+import functools
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+# Imported before any test runs the patch, so they keep Megatron's own spec builders and TopKRouter.
+from megatron.core.models.backends import LocalSpecProvider
+from megatron.core.models.gpt import gpt_layer_specs, moe_module_specs  # noqa: F401
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe import moe_layer
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe.router import InferenceTopKRouter
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.moe.router import (
+    PrimusTopKRouter,
+    primus_topk_router_for,
+)
+from primus.backends.megatron.patches.moe_patches import topk_router_patches
+from primus.core.patches.context import PatchContext
+
+# Megatron's own class: the patch rebinds the name ``TopKRouter`` inside Megatron's modules.
+TopKRouter = PrimusTopKRouter.__bases__[0]
+
+
+def test_swap_rule():
+    assert TopKRouter.__name__ == "TopKRouter"
+    assert primus_topk_router_for(TopKRouter) is PrimusTopKRouter
+    for router in (PrimusTopKRouter, InferenceTopKRouter, functools.partial(TopKRouter)):
+        assert primus_topk_router_for(router) is router
+    # matched by name, so a TopKRouter some module bound before the patch ran is caught too
+    assert primus_topk_router_for(type("TopKRouter", (), {})) is PrimusTopKRouter
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("router", [TopKRouter, InferenceTopKRouter], ids=lambda r: r.__name__)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("as_partial", [True, False], ids=["partial_core_v0.19", "module_spec"])
+def test_spec_router(router, as_partial):
+    submodules = moe_layer.MoESubmodules(experts=None, router=router)
+    if as_partial:
+        spec = functools.partial(moe_layer.MoELayer, submodules=submodules)
+    else:
+        spec = ModuleSpec(module=moe_layer.MoELayer, submodules=submodules)
+    assert topk_router_patches._use_primus_topk_router_in_moe_spec(spec) is spec
+    assert submodules.router is (PrimusTopKRouter if router is TopKRouter else router)
+
+
+def _run_patch(mp):
+    """Run the patch under ``mp``, which restores every global the patch rebinds.
+
+    The real ``MoELayer.__init__`` needs process groups, so the patch wraps a stand-in that records
+    the router it is handed; the recorded routers are returned.
+    """
+    mp.setattr(topk_router_patches, "log_rank_0", lambda *args, **kwargs: None)
+    router_module = sys.modules["megatron.core.transformer.moe.router"]
+    mp.setattr(router_module, "TopKRouter", router_module.TopKRouter)
+    mp.setattr(moe_layer, "TopKRouter", moe_layer.TopKRouter)
+    field = moe_layer.MoESubmodules.__dataclass_fields__["router"]
+    mp.setattr(field, "default", field.default)
+    mp.setattr(field, "default_factory", field.default_factory)
+    for name in ("get_moe_module_spec_for_backend", "get_moe_module_spec"):
+        mp.setattr(moe_module_specs, name, getattr(moe_module_specs, name))
+    routers = []
+    mp.setattr(
+        moe_layer.MoELayer,
+        "__init__",
+        lambda self, config, submodules=None, *args, **kwargs: routers.append(submodules.router),
+    )
+    module_config = SimpleNamespace(params=SimpleNamespace(disable_primus_topk_router=False))
+    topk_router_patches.patch_primus_topk_router(
+        PatchContext(backend="megatron", phase="build_args", extra={"module_config": module_config})
+    )
+    return routers
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def patched(monkeypatch):
+    return _run_patch(monkeypatch)
+
+
+def test_gpt_moe_spec_gets_primus_router(patched):
+    for spec in (
+        moe_module_specs.get_moe_module_spec_for_backend(backend=LocalSpecProvider(), num_experts=4),
+        moe_module_specs.get_moe_module_spec(use_te=False, num_experts=4),
+    ):
+        submodules = spec.keywords["submodules"] if isinstance(spec, functools.partial) else spec.submodules
+        assert submodules.router is PrimusTopKRouter
+
+
+def test_moe_layer_init_swaps_only_megatron_topk_router(patched):
+    for router in (TopKRouter, InferenceTopKRouter, PrimusTopKRouter):
+        moe_layer.MoELayer(SimpleNamespace(), moe_layer.MoESubmodules(experts=None, router=router))
+    assert patched == [PrimusTopKRouter, InferenceTopKRouter, PrimusTopKRouter]
+
+
+def test_patch_globals_restored():
+    # other tests build plain Megatron MoE layers in the same process
+    field = moe_layer.MoESubmodules.__dataclass_fields__["router"]
+    before = (
+        moe_layer.MoELayer.__init__,
+        moe_layer.TopKRouter,
+        field.default,
+        moe_module_specs.get_moe_module_spec_for_backend,
+        moe_module_specs.get_moe_module_spec,
+    )
+    with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
+        _run_patch(mp)
+        assert moe_layer.TopKRouter is PrimusTopKRouter
+    assert before == (
+        moe_layer.MoELayer.__init__,
+        moe_layer.TopKRouter,
+        field.default,
+        moe_module_specs.get_moe_module_spec_for_backend,
+        moe_module_specs.get_moe_module_spec,
+    )

+"""Building ``PrimusTurboMegaMoELayer`` the way Megatron builds an MoE layer, without a GPU.
+
+``tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_mega_moe.py`` checks the layer's numerics, but it needs 8 gfx950
+GPUs and so never runs in CI. This covers what the constructor and the router call do with
+Megatron-core 0.19's MoE spec and with the extra arguments Megatron-LM main passes. The Turbo kernels
+are stubbed out: nothing here reaches them.
+"""
+
+import functools
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
+
+import megatron.training
+import pytest
+import torch
+from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_layer_specs import get_gpt_layer_local_spec
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe.moe_layer import MoESubmodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe.router import InferenceTopKRouter
+from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import ModuleSpec, get_submodules
+from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+
+from primus.backends.megatron.core.transformer.moe.router import PrimusTopKRouter
+
+# Megatron's own class: the router patch rebinds the name ``TopKRouter`` inside Megatron's modules.
+TopKRouter = PrimusTopKRouter.__bases__[0]
+
+_MEGA_MOE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "primus/backends/megatron/core/extensions/mega_moe.py"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def mega_moe():
+    """``mega_moe.py`` loaded under a private name, with the two Turbo op modules it imports stubbed."""
+    with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
+        for name in (
+            "primus_turbo",
+            "primus_turbo.pytorch",
+            "primus_turbo.pytorch.ops",
+            "primus_turbo.pytorch.ops.moe",
+        ):
+            if name not in sys.modules:
+                package = ModuleType(name)
+                package.__path__ = []
+                mp.setitem(sys.modules, name, package)
+        ops = ModuleType("primus_turbo.pytorch.ops.moe.fused_mega_moe")
+        ops.GLUActivation = object
+        ops.fused_mega_moe_stage1 = ops.fused_mega_moe_stage2 = None
+        fp8_ops = ModuleType("primus_turbo.pytorch.ops.moe.fused_mega_moe_fp8")
+        fp8_ops.fused_mega_moe_fp8_stage1 = fp8_ops.fused_mega_moe_fp8_stage2 = None
+        mp.setitem(sys.modules, ops.__name__, ops)
+        mp.setitem(sys.modules, fp8_ops.__name__, fp8_ops)
+
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mega_moe_under_test", _MEGA_MOE)
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def args(monkeypatch):
+    """The Megatron args MegaMoE reads; the layer imports ``get_args`` when it needs it."""
+    args = SimpleNamespace(turbo_mega_moe_precision="bf16", disable_primus_topk_router=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(megatron.training, "get_args", lambda: args)
+    return args
+
+
+class _RouterCalled(Exception):
+    """Raised by the stub router so ``forward`` stops before the (stubbed) kernels."""
+
+
+def _stub_router(record):
+    class StubRouter(torch.nn.Module):
+        topk = 2
+
+        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+            super().__init__()
+            record["router"] = kwargs
+
+        def forward(self, hidden_states, padding_mask=None, **kwargs):
+            record["route"] = (padding_mask, kwargs)
+            raise _RouterCalled
+
+    return StubRouter
+
+
+def _stub_shared_experts(record):
+    def build(**kwargs):
+        record["shared_experts"] = kwargs
+        return torch.nn.Identity()
+
+    return build
+
+
+def _config(shared_expert=True):
+    return TransformerConfig(
+        num_layers=1,
+        hidden_size=32,
+        num_attention_heads=2,
+        num_moe_experts=4,
+        moe_ffn_hidden_size=8,
+        moe_router_topk=2,
+        moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size=8 if shared_expert else None,
+        gated_linear_unit=True,
+        activation_func=torch.nn.functional.silu,
+        add_bias_linear=False,
+        params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        bf16=True,
+        use_cpu_initialization=True,
+    )
+
+
+class _EPGroup:
+    def size(self):
+        return 1
+
+    def rank(self):
+        return 0
+
+
+_PG_COLLECTION = SimpleNamespace(ep=_EPGroup())
+
+
+def _build(mega_moe, submodules, config=None, **kwargs):
+    # how Megatron's TransformerLayer builds its MLP: a builder called with keywords only
+    builder = functools.partial(mega_moe.PrimusTurboMegaMoELayer, submodules=submodules)
+    return builder(config=config or _config(), pg_collection=_PG_COLLECTION, is_mtp_layer=False, **kwargs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("disable", [False, True], ids=["primus_router", "disable_primus_topk_router"])
+def test_router_follows_the_router_patch(mega_moe, args, disable):
+    args.disable_primus_topk_router = disable
+    # Megatron-core 0.19's GPT MoE spec is a functools.partial whose router is left at the default
+    submodules = get_submodules(get_gpt_layer_local_spec(num_experts=4).submodules.mlp)
+    for router in (TopKRouter, submodules.router):
+        assert mega_moe.mega_moe_router(router) is (router if disable else PrimusTopKRouter)
+    for router in (PrimusTopKRouter, InferenceTopKRouter, functools.partial(TopKRouter)):
+        assert mega_moe.mega_moe_router(router) is router
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["decoder.layers.3.mlp", None])
+def test_build_with_core_v019_layer_arguments(mega_moe, args, name):
+    record = {}
+    submodules = MoESubmodules(
+        experts=None, shared_experts=_stub_shared_experts(record), router=_stub_router(record)
+    )
+    config = _config()
+    layer = _build(mega_moe, submodules, config, name=name)
+
+    assert record["router"] == dict(config=config, pg_collection=_PG_COLLECTION, is_mtp_layer=False)
+    expected_name = None if name is None else name + ".shared_experts"
+    assert record["shared_experts"] == dict(
+        config=config, pg_collection=_PG_COLLECTION, gate=False, name=expected_name
+    )
+    assert layer.experts.fc1_weight.weight.shape == (4, 2 * 8, 32)  # [experts, 2 * ffn, hidden]
+
+
+def test_module_spec_shared_experts_are_built_without_a_name(mega_moe, args):
+    record = {}
+
+    class SharedExperts(torch.nn.Identity):
+        def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+            super().__init__()
+            record["shared_experts"] = kwargs
+
+    submodules = MoESubmodules(
+        experts=None, shared_experts=ModuleSpec(module=SharedExperts), router=_stub_router(record)
+    )
+    _build(mega_moe, submodules, name="decoder.layers.3.mlp")
+    assert "name" not in record["shared_experts"]
+
+
+def test_shared_experts_builder_required(mega_moe, args):
+    submodules = MoESubmodules(experts=None, router=_stub_router({}))
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError, match="Shared experts builder"):
+        _build(mega_moe, submodules)
+    _build(mega_moe, submodules, config=_config(shared_expert=False))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("threshold", [None, 2])
+def test_megatron_main_hash_moe_layer_threshold(mega_moe, args, threshold):
+    # Megatron-LM main's TransformerLayer passes it to every MLP builder, None unless hash routing is on
+    record = {}
+    submodules = MoESubmodules(
+        experts=None, shared_experts=_stub_shared_experts(record), router=_stub_router(record)
+    )
+    _build(mega_moe, submodules, hash_moe_layer_threshold=threshold)
+    assert record["router"].get("hash_moe_layer_threshold") == threshold
+    assert ("hash_moe_layer_threshold" in record["router"]) == (threshold is not None)
+
+
+def test_router_gets_only_the_routing_inputs_it_is_given(mega_moe, args):
+    record = {}
+    submodules = MoESubmodules(
+        experts=None, shared_experts=_stub_shared_experts(record), router=_stub_router(record)
+    )
+    layer = _build(mega_moe, submodules)
+    hidden_states = torch.zeros(5, 3, 32, dtype=torch.bfloat16)  # [seq, batch, hidden]
+    padding_mask = torch.zeros(3, 5, dtype=torch.bool)  # [batch, seq]
+
+    # Megatron-core 0.19 passes only padding_mask, which the layer hands over sequence-first
+    with pytest.raises(_RouterCalled):
+        layer(hidden_states, padding_mask=padding_mask)
+    routed_mask, router_kwargs = record["route"]
+    assert routed_mask.shape == (5, 3) and router_kwargs == {}
+
+    # Megatron-LM main adds the token ids (hash routing) and the packed-sequence params
+    input_ids, packed_seq_params = torch.zeros(3, 5, dtype=torch.long), object()
+    with pytest.raises(_RouterCalled):
+        layer(
+            hidden_states, padding_mask=padding_mask, input_ids=input_ids, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+        )
+    router_kwargs = record["route"][1]
+    assert set(router_kwargs) == {"input_ids", "packed_seq_params"}
+    assert router_kwargs["input_ids"] is input_ids
+    assert router_kwargs["packed_seq_params"] is packed_seq_params

<details><summary>Nits and less certain findings (3)</summary>

**1. Router swap rule duplicated with divergent logic and global `get_args()` dependency** (`primus/backends/megatron/core/extensions/mega_moe.py:86`)

`mega_moe_router` copies the `TopKRouter`→`PrimusTopKRouter` rename rule and the `disable_primus_topk_router` check from `patched_moelayer_init` in `topk_router_patches.py`. A future change to the rule (a new router class, the deprecated MoE path) has to be made in both places. Consider sharing one helper. `get_args()` is reached only for routers named `TopKRouter`, and the layer already needed initialised args through `mega_moe_precision()`, so this adds no new construction requirement.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers changing the PrimusTopKRouter swap rule; there is no runtime impact for users of MegaMoE.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**2. Comments wrongly claim the reference `MoELayer` uses `PrimusTopKRouter`** (`tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_mega_moe.py:190-210`)

The retained comment 'mega layer reuses the same router/shared-expert submodules' in `_build_layers` is now only half true. MegaMoE receives the same `submodules`, but `mega_moe_router` turns `TopKRouter` into `PrimusTopKRouter`, while the unpatched reference `MoELayer` keeps plain `TopKRouter`. Parity therefore rests on `_create_args` turning off the PrimusTopKRouter-only branches (`enable_primus_turbo=False`, `router_logit_softcapping=None`, `moe_router_force_load_balancing=False`). The comment could say so. The new docstring and the new test comment are accurate: in a patched run, `MoELayer` still gets `PrimusTopKRouter` on v0.19.

**Who is affected:** Readers and maintainers of the MegaMoE parity test only; there is no runtime effect.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

**3. New pure-Python router and shared-expert logic lacks CPU unit tests** (`tests/unit_tests/megatron/moe/test_mega_moe.py:190-210`)

The new `mega_moe_router` and shared-experts dispatch are pure Python, but they are only exercised by `test_mega_moe.py`. That file skips at module level unless the GPU is gfx950, and its parity tests need 8 GPUs. Only the default `TopKRouter` -> `PrimusTopKRouter` swap is asserted. The `disable_primus_topk_router` opt-out, the passthrough for non-`TopKRouter` routers, the `ModuleSpec` vs builder-callable branch not taken by the pinned Megatron, and the `name + '.shared_experts'` propagation are untested. Consider small CPU tests, e.g. `mega_moe_router(TopKRouter) is PrimusTopKRouter` with a stubbed `get_args`.

**Who is affected:** Maintainers only: regressions in the opt-out or the version-dispatch branches would go unnoticed on CI runners without 8 gfx950 GPUs.

_Checked against the code by an independent pass._

</details>
